description: Repairs r-sql-2-3/pivot-schema-lifetime: Requery was called on a snapshot. Asks when the crosstab schema is published and how long it lasts, with the recordset opened as a dynaset (type 2) and Requery() called without argument: saved crosstab QXtab (PARAMETERS pMin Long) Fields before and after pMin = 0; Fields after OpenRecordset, MoveNext and MoveLast; a new pivot value 'new' inserted; Requery(), schema and rows; pMin = 3 and Requery() again; then saved QXFixed. Fixture r-fix-expr-sql-expr is opened on a writable fresh copy through DAO.DBEngine.120; each recordset reads Name, Type and Value of every field. Each statement is preceded by a marker (a DROP TABLE of a table that does not exist, which always fails), so DBEngine.Errors read after the statement shows that statement's own failure or the marker's, never an older one. Where Field Precision and Scale are read, the recordset is first positioned on its first row (MoveFirst) and DecimalPlaces is not read.
retentionNote: Designed r-fix-expr-sql probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
